evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Jules moved directly into logistics probing without the standard two-concerns opener.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concerns were raised by the customer, so no follow-up was possible or required.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Not addressed. Jules quoted a specific time window (8:30-9am morning, 12pm-2pm afternoon) but never explored whether the customer was on a Best Value Day or offered dollar savings for alternative dates.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Jules said 'Do you want me to get this moved scheduled for you?' but made no mention of rate lock or no-deposit guarantee before the ask.

top_strength: Jules delivered a clear, all-inclusive pricing framing ($222/hour for two movers and one truck, no hidden fees, tools and blankets included) and confirmed the quote via email without requiring the customer to take notes.
coaching_note: Jules never asked the two-concerns question (on-time guarantee and damage protection) or delivered the two promises—these are the backbone of step 3 and should come before diving into logistics; also, Value Days (identifying cheaper move dates and offering dollar savings) was completely skipped, and the final concerns check in step 6 was never asked.
